name: cris-logic-artisan
description: Cris Logic Artisan (CLA) — a Claude Code dev-workflow harness: spec-to-pr, the multi-* chains, lite-pr, the retro/codify self-improvement loops, review skills, and the generic git/worktree guard hooks.

plugins.name: cla
plugins.description: The stable channel. Tracks the `v1` tag, which moves only on a deliberate release. Install this one unless you are working on the harness itself.

plugins.name: cla-edge
plugins.description: The moving channel. Tracks `main`, so it carries whatever landed most recently — including changes that have not been exercised in a consuming repo yet. Use it to test a fix before it is released, not to get work done.
